digest: Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD) is characterized by cysts from different nephron segments, yet their origin remains inaccessible to in vivo imaging.

Building on ex vivo studies that cyst sodium concentration ([Na+]) may reflect tubular origin, we developed a non-invasive 23Na magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) approach at 7 Tesla to phenotype ADPKD cysts in vivo based on cyst sodium.
High-[Na+] cysts were 1.8-fold more frequent overall.

evidence.quote: The vasopressin V2 receptor (V2R), the therapeutic target of tolvaptan, was detected exclusively in low-[Na+] cysts, linking sodium phenotype to therapeutic target expression.
